ios.desc:
Featured by Apple as Game of the Day and in New Games We Love. Downloaded over 800,000 times.

1 Chance is a collection of tiny, beautifully made games that test your timing, memory, logic, words and more. Every game takes seconds to learn and one try to prove yourself.

DAILY CHANCE
Five new games every day, the same for everyone in the world. About three minutes. One try each. Build a streak, beat your best and share your score card with friends.

THE ONE CHANCE
14 classic games, remastered. You can only ever play them once. No practice, no restarts, no second go. Find a quiet moment and make it count. If a call or crash interrupts you, you get a fair fresh go.

OVER 90 GAMES
Stop the clock to the millisecond. Pour a drink to the line. Remember a constellation. Sort the water. Crown the board. Spot the odd shade. Fold a cube in your head. Find words in a letter grid. Pin a city on a 3D globe. Every game is built from scratch with gorgeous animation, satisfying haptics and sound.

CHESS AND SUDOKU, THE CLASSICS
Two complete premium games for Pro members. Chess with a beautiful 3D board, five computer opponents, a full course of 31 lessons from first moves to endgames, 783 puzzles and a review of every game. Sudoku with five levels from Easy to Master, a Daily Sudoku and hints that teach you the technique. Free players can try both with a short ad.

TEN SKILLS, ONE PROFILE
Timing, speed, memory, math, words, perception, precision, knowledge, spatial and logic. Your skill profile shows where you shine and where to grow, and Insights reveal your form, your trends and the time of day you play best.

STREAKS THAT MATTER
Keep your flame alive with a beautiful streak tracker, a month by month calendar and milestones to chase. Miss a day? Save your streak. Earn achievements as you go, and unlock new app icons along the way.

MADE FOR EVERYONE
• Full VoiceOver support and Dynamic Type
• Assist mode with longer clocks
• Designed for iPhone and iPad
• Available in 14 languages: English, Chinese (Traditional), Danish, Dutch, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Spanish and Swedish
• Game Center leaderboards and achievements
• Gentle daily reminders, only if you want them

1 CHANCE PRO
Go further with Pro:
• A bonus game every day
• Practice any game, any time, as often as you like
• The Secret Vault, with new games every month
• Play every past Daily you missed
• Streak shields that protect your streak automatically
• Full Insight

quotes.text:
That's such a lovely idea. Reminds me of a game made by one of my friends: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/1-chance/id1529736678

The game itself seems pretty trivial. What makes it really interesting is that you get only one chance to play it.
